not_covered.note_code: These need the running application: model the threats in Threat models and scan the deployed site from Domains.
not_covered.title_image: What an image scan doesn't cover
not_covered.note_image: An image scan reads the packages and the configuration inside the image. How the application behaves needs a scan of its code and of the deployed site.
not_covered.title_web: What a passive web scan doesn't cover
not_covered.note_web: A passive scan only reads what the site returns, without sending attacks. Active testing (injection, sign-in, access control between users) wasn't run.
